task.paper_title: Focused curve extraction benchmark v4.1: Raman 01
task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel Raman benchmark chart, variant 01. Scenario: two offset D/G spectra.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel Raman spectrum benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel Raman spectrum with two offset traces and an in-panel legend. The full figure corresponds to the target panel; the D and G letters mark spectral features, not panel labels. Axes, legend, and tick labels are fully retained in the conservative crop.

x.visible_pattern: Visible x ticks are numeric and evenly spaced from 500 to 2500.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose linear with normalized RMSE about 0.0003; log10 fit was much worse.

y.visible_pattern: Visible y ticks are numeric and evenly spaced from 0 to 1400 in 200-unit steps.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose linear with normalized RMSE about 0.0004; log10 is incompatible because a visible zero tick is present.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: Both traces are clearly separated throughout the main plot; no recoverable hidden segments were observed.

curves.overlap_notes: Curve is visually distinct from the dashed blue trace across the full plotted extent.
Dashed spectrum is clearly separated from the solid black spectrum; point sampling follows visible dash segments only.

response.interpretation_notes: Two offset Raman spectra are present in the main plot: a lower solid black trace and an upper dashed blue trace, each spanning the full x-range with distinct D and G peaks.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage

panels.overlap_recovery_reason: Both traces are clearly separated throughout the main plot; no recoverable hidden segments were observed.
